notes.title: Thumpy Screenshake Update 1.0.7
notes.content:
In this update, I focused on fine tuning the camera and player movement to feel more weighty and satisfying.

Update 1.0.7
[list]
[*] Improvements to the feel of camera and player movement
[*] Increased the amount of hang time for the player's jump
[*] Improved screen shake and added screen shake to more things
[*] Wrong clones now only make terrifying noises when not held
[*] Wrong clones now have a visual indicator that they're making a terrifying noise
[*] Slowed down humans (they're still very fast)
[*] Reduced intro video volume
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera could stutter for a frame on the initial zoom in from the map
[*] Fixed an issue where the player would shake when falling into a 1x1 gap near the center of the rotational ring
[/list]

notes.title: Terrifying Wrongclone Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
Update 1.0.5
[list]
[*] It is now possible to traumatize your enemies with the wrong clone
[*] The wrong clone walks away from you the first time it gets up
[*] The wrong clone is slightly faster
[*] Pinger and Clacker are now angered by the wrong clone
[*] Added maps for Meat Packing
[*] Added maps for Tactical Training
[*] Changed props and backgrounds that conflicted with themes for Electrical and Tactical Training
[*] Made mannequin matter costs the same as human matter costs.
[*] The decelerator scientists have better things to do than stand around and wait for you to come back now

[*] Tutorial prompts no longer flash ui elements if you've devoured the scientists who are supposed to give you the prompts
[*] Improved the decelerator clamp colliders
[*] positioned builder boxes so that items don't fall behind them
[*] Added screen shake when Palti falls on his butt
[*] Gave acid traps more juice
[*] Tools now do full hitting damage
[*] Improved the way damage knockback works
[*] Made shooting rail lasers more consistent
[*] Adjusted song volumes
[*] Improved camera smoothing
[*] Fixed an issue where restocking the items and enemies in an area could change the background blocks
[*] Fixed an issue where you could jump less high holding a mannequin
[*] Fixed an issue where the player swung the wrong way when swinging from the ground on the decelerator in Crate Mode. (winner of the most specific bug award)
[*] Fixed an issue where guards could drop an invincible gun in rare situations
[*] Fixed an issue where ragdoll heads could freeze for a frame when a character starts ragdolling
[/list]

notes.title: CreatorCrate enters 1.0!
notes.content:
I made the decision to move the versioning up to 1.0 in preparation for the game's release this fall. No more beta disclaimer, and the debug info is off by default now. Thank you so much to everyone who's playtested and been excited for the game's development. We're in the final stretch now!

Update 1.0.2
[list]
[*] Removed wishlist and beta messages from non-demo builds
[*] Debug info is off by default in the closed Beta
[*] Added many new maps in Electrical and Quarters areas
[*] Removed repair prompts from infinite matter mode because the challenge prevents repairing
[*] Fixed an issue with the menu music not looping
[*] Fixed an issue where players could activate and load from a checkpoint that could prevent getting the shoveball
[*] Fixed an issue with the ship terminal speaking at the wrong time
[*] Fixed menu issues related to non-compatible save games
[*] The player now stops swinging when a block you're grabbed onto is destroyed in crate mode.
[*] Made more objects swingable in the Crate Mode challenge
[*] Made shoveballs release your hold on platforms in the Palti fight in the Crate Mode challenge.
[*] Blocks blow up easier in the Action Movie challenge
[*] Made ascending into the decelerator in Crate Mode easier[*]
[/list]

notes.title: More exciting permadeath Update 0.32.0
notes.content:
This update restocks items and enemies in certain sections to make permadeath runs more exciting. It also helps to make sure that you have enough matter to complete the Hongry challenge. Have fun!

[list]
[*] Restocked items and enemies in backtrack sections to make the areas more interesting on permadeath.
[*] Made the mech reinforcement bar more intuitive
[*] Added more overlay messages.
[*] Changed decelerator port names to be area names
[*] Moved the game win stats screen to after the end cut scene
[*] Fixed an issue with the mouse stealing focus in the control remapping screen
[*] Made it easier to swing on rotating lamps.
[/list]

notes.title: Camera Improvements: Update 0.24.0
notes.content:
In this update, I fine tuned the default camera to be smoother. I also added a reduced camera motion setting for motion sensitive players. This turns off the usual way that the camera tilts in the direction of movement and prevents the camera from following the mouse.

[list]
[*] Made camera motion smoother.
[*] Added an option to reduce the camera motion for motion sensitive players.
[*] Improved 1 way laser colliders.
[*] Fine tuned the way that decompression interacts with physics objects.
[*] Made the camera return to a more neutral position when closing the map.
[*] Added a size changing effect to give picking up items more JUICE!
[*] Put in item droppers to prevent soft locks during item tutorials.
[*] Added sounds for item droppers and item launchers.
[*] Added a prompt for difficulty setting.
[/list]

tags.feature: [*] Made camera motion smoother.
[*] Added an option to reduce the camera motion for motion sensitive players.
[*] Improved 1 way laser colliders.
[*] Fine tuned the way that decompression interacts with physics objects.

[*] Added a size changing effect to give picking up items more JUICE!
[*] Put in item droppers to prevent soft locks during item tutorials.

[*] Added a prompt for difficulty setting.

notes.title: Sniper Section Balance Update 0.23.0
notes.content:
This update fine tunes the balance in the new sniper section.

[list]
[*] Made snipers aim slower to give the player a chance.
[*] Decreased the trap density in the new sniper section.
[*] Made rotating lasers rotate slower.
[*] Added more lore holes. . . You know you want them.
[*] Made smoke easier to see through for the player.
[*] Tweaked maps based on playtest feedback.
[*] Fixed an issue where knives were having weird interactions with builder boxes.
[*] Fixed issues with dialog arrows and popup text jittering when rounding corners in zero gravity.
[/list]

notes.title: Ultra Broom Update!
notes.content:
Update 0.20.0
[list]
[*] You can now sweep up debris with the broom.
[*] Added a sequence that plays when you find new tools.
[*] Added character names to the dialog window.
[*] The fan pushes smoke now!
[*] Made fan travel slower to help precision maneuvering.
[*] Added subtitles to the intro video.
[*] Changed the menu and UI to have a blue/yellow/red palette.
[*] Changed the menu font.
[*] Fire is anchored at the middle of the player now.
[*] Made the input for throwing items for forgiving.
[*] Made it harder to get sucked into the cold, merciless clutches of space while standing in an airlock.
[*] Improved the player's getting crushed animation.
[*] Improved the CreatorCrate model in the ending cutscene.
[*] Made the ship console bigger and changed its missile icons.
[*] Added some spiffy new intro screens.
[*] Added more Steam achievements.
[*] Added a spin down sequence.
[*] Made intro video play on new game.
[*] Changed the way that user is selected in the menu.
[*] Move "permadeath" option to difficulty menu.
[*] Made acid effects more glowy.
[*] Gave humans a "pressing button" animation.
[*] Made popup text for when alarms and scientists alert humans.
[*] Fixed issues related to the placement of the player's map marker when in the decelerator.
[*] Fixed a Linux specific issue where blueprint images disappear after changing resolution settings.
[*] Fixed an issue where background sounds play while in menus
[*] Fixed an issue where the ui briefly shows up at the start of the intro zoom in
[*] Fixed an issue where creating a wrongclone on a ladder resulted in getting slowly dragged down the ladder.
[*] Fixed an issue where using a shoveball on a ladder would prevent you from jumping off of the ladder.
[*]	Fixed an issue where humans sometimes kept talking to you from beyond the grave.
[*] Fixed an issue where humans restock their weapons when the player is near.
[*] Fixed an issue where the item in the players hand was not being crushed by platforms.
[*] Fixed an issue where npcs starting paths while jumping which could lead to double jumps.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player sometimes spawned in the wrong place during the zeroG	 demo skip.
[*] Fixed an issue involving REDACTED.
[*] Improved npcs picking up guns when they don't have one.
[*] Improved and sped up the way humans jump from wall to wall in zero gravity.
[*] Improved smoke collisions with walls.
[*] Improved walking path finding.
[*] Cleaned up the way areas are blocked off in the demo.
[/list]
